description: Model agreement analysis and ensemble optimization - analyze model consensus patterns and optimize ensemble weighting with historical validation
steps: Create backend/app/prediction/agreement_analyzer.py using EnsembleEngine model_agreement to create historically-validated agreement buckets
Create backend/scripts/analyze_model_agreement.py to evaluate correlation between agreement scores and actual prediction reliability
Add OptimizedWeights strategy to backend/app/prediction/ensemble_engine.py for historical performance-based weighting
Create backend/scripts/optimize_ensemble_weights.py to compare current ReliabilityWeights vs optimized weights using walk-forward validation
Create backend/app/prediction/model_contribution.py to analyze individual model contribution to ensemble performance
acceptance_criteria: Agreement analyzer creates high/medium/high-disagreement buckets with historical performance validation
Agreement analysis shows correlation between model consensus and prediction reliability using real historical data
Ensemble weight optimization uses walk-forward validation ensuring training data before T, validation data after T
Weight optimization shows genuine OOS improvement or recommends keeping existing ReliabilityWeights strategy
Model contribution analysis evaluates single-model vs ensemble performance on adequate sample sizes using multiple metrics
verification: python backend/scripts/analyze_model_agreement.py outputs agreement-reliability correlation analysis with historical validation
python backend/scripts/optimize_ensemble_weights.py either promotes optimized weights or recommends keeping current ensemble based on OOS results
python backend/scripts/evaluate_model_contributions.py completes contribution analysis for all 4 operational models
